message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount |
|----------|------------|----------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 cloves |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) can |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt | 1 tsp |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | ¼ tsp |
| | Fresh parsley or basil (optional) | 2 Tbsp chopped |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup |
| | Beef broth or water | ½ cup |
| | Sugar (to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil | 2 Tbsp chopped |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| **Bechamel Sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk | 4 cups (1 L) |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated) | Pinch |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| **Cheese Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach (blanched & squeezed dry) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms (sautéed) | 1 cup |
| | Caramelized onions | ½ cup |
| | Pesto | ¼ cup |

### Quick Tips
- **No‑boil sheets** save time; just add a little extra liquid to the sauce.
- For a richer flavor, brown the meat before adding tomatoes.
- If you’re short on time, use pre‑made marinara sauce instead of making your own.
- Layer the pasta, sauce, ricotta mixture, béchamel, and cheeses as you build the dish.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
